description: Three independent CV sequencers of 3, 5 and 7 steps, each clocked by its own trigger, so the three patterns drift against each other.

params.text: Sets the voltage for that step of the three-step row, -1 to +1 before the SPREAD scaling.
Sets the voltage for that step of the five-step row, -1 to +1 before the SPREAD scaling.
Sets the voltage for that step of the seven-step row, -1 to +1 before the SPREAD scaling.
Makes each trigger jump to a step picked at random within its row instead of moving to the next one.
Scales every step voltage in all three rows, 1 to 5, so a knob at its end gives that many volts.

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V moves the three-step row on by one step, or to a random one of its three.
A rising edge past 1V moves the five-step row on by one step, or to a random one of its five.
A rising edge past 1V moves the seven-step row on by one step, or to a random one of its seven.

outputs.text: The voltage of the three-step row's current step, between -5V and +5V depending on SPREAD.
The voltage of the five-step row's current step, between -5V and +5V depending on SPREAD.
The voltage of the seven-step row's current step, between -5V and +5V depending on SPREAD.

notes: There is no reset input and no clock of its own. Each row only moves when a trigger arrives at its own jack, and the rows are meant to free-run and phase against each other.
The step positions are not saved with the patch, so every row starts again at its first step when a patch is loaded.

high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
